items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: I, oh yeah, I play with old, Perez, Onward band. Years ago I went along with them, you know, play extra with them, you know.

ctx.x: We have a lot of later pictures of parades and all, just hoping to find some of those real old bands. I was going to ask about Manuel Perez and the Onward band. Oh yeah, old, yeah.

I, oh yeah, I play with old, Perez, Onward band. Years ago I went along with them, you know, play extra with them, you know. I play with all them old band actually. They come and get me. Mad drums sometimes, sometimes bassmen, all them old times. All those old time bands, they, they went out so, certainly, when this new stuff come in, old bands, look like they just went out. I tell you what started that, those school bands. See the people tried to pull me those school bands, you know. Yep. And Perez rather than…
I've heard about that too. I played it, I played it.
